target_findings.explanation: At mint(address,uint256), the checked privilege permits positive additional rights for the controller or a beneficiary it can select. A balance increase for an independent ordinary buyer alone does not satisfy this condition.

The assessment concerns a common restriction on ordinary outgoing transfers at source offset 2421. The scoped controller change prevents the same positive outgoing use for ordinary holders without an applicable exempt agent. A committing use and its control direction were checked on the actual ledger. An already exempt agent may serve the same request if the holder granted the required allowance.
